Gnosis VPN for Windows (test build)

1. Extract this zip into your own Downloads folder (right-click > Extract All); not under C:\ directly.
2. Double-click Install.cmd and allow the admin prompt. If SmartScreen appears: More info > Run anyway.
3. The app starts by itself; later use Start menu > Gnosis VPN.

Uninstall.cmd removes it again (the node identity in C:\ProgramData\GnosisVPN is kept).
